svg.title: Compact-germ gluing and general topological proper base change

cc:Work.dc:title: Compact-germ gluing and general topological proper base change
cc:Work.dc:description: Set-inclusion schematic for GP2--GP3 and the actual restriction square for GP7--GP11. Compact K has ambient point separation; neither ambient space is assumed Hausdorff or locally compact. All inclusions are non-strict.

cc:Agent.dc:title: GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI), Ultra; reproducible Matplotlib source
Original explanatory figure CC0. Mathematical references and component notices remain in the lesson.
